name: Everything
usage: Type a file or folder name; Everything search syntax is supported
usage_detail: file <keywords>, e.g. file *.sln, file report ext:pdf
not_running_detail: Start Everything (voidtools) to search files; Enter launches it when installed
busy: Everything is busy — press Enter to retry
unsupported: Everything search is only available on Windows
incomplete: Results may be incomplete — press Enter to retry
retry_detail: Everything answered too slowly, usually while it updates its index after many file changes
